selection: Present >=600; earlier samples excluded by explicit frame-count threshold
scope: Sum of GPU draw-render-pass durations only; excludes clears, uploads, gaps between passes and Present copy. Host encoding is wall time including awaited pipeline creation, not CPU busy time. Timestamp precision is browser-dependent; zero durations may reflect quantization.
limitations: Instrumented, screenshot-free run. Sum of pass durations is not full GPU frame duration or shader-only execution time. Observed timestamp granularity limits per-pass accuracy; host wall time is not CPU utilization. No display FPS or instrument-free performance claim.
